metadata.definition_note: All 42 catalogued test cases have a data-definition object. Only seven cases have executable input data consumed by tests/test_campus_booking.py. Other cases are draft inputs for future implementation and execution.
metadata.data_schema: Every one of the 42 catalogued cases now exposes test_data_id, setup, input, expected, assertion, definition_status and execution_ready. Only the seven cases in acceptance_test_data.json are runtime executable in the current test script.
